mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settle_round ( settlement_id, round_number, place_name, receipt_total, adjustment_amount ) VALUES ( #{settlementId}, #{roundNumber}, #{placeName}, #{receiptTotal}, COALESCE(#{adjustmentAmount}, 0) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, settlement_id, round_number, place_name, receipt_total, adjustment_amount FROM settle_round WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} ORDER BY round_number ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, settlement_id, round_number, place_name, receipt_total, adjustment_amount FROM settle_round WHERE id = #{id} AND settlement_id = #{settlementId}
